claim.statement: Current Aider documentation separates code mode, which changes files; ask mode, which discusses code without changing files; architect mode, which uses an architect and editor path; and help mode.

source.title: Aider chat modes
source.locator: Chat modes and Architect mode and the editor model

limitations: Mode names do not establish the effective mode of any session or prove enforcement of a non-writing boundary.
unknowns: The active mode, per-message override, models and auto-accept behavior are unknown.
